name: Plexus
author: E. T. Carter
description: A loose constellation of glow-dot nodes hung across the dark, each slowly circling its own anchor, now stacked into depth layers that recede back-to-front — finer, dimmer and softer behind so the web reads as a volume rather than a wallpaper. Hairline threads glow in between nodes that drift within reach, their colour running from one end's hue to the other, and faint triangle ghosts settle behind clustered triples. Connections form and dissolve by proximity while a barely-there wave breathes diagonally across the net.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: Scales how fast nodes circle their anchors, from a near-frozen hush to a visibly restless mesh of forming and breaking threads.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Spacing of the front node grid in CSS px; smaller packs more nodes, threads and triangle ghosts into view, larger leaves a sparse open net.

params.label: Reach
params.effect: Multiplier on the proximity threshold where threads fade in; low gives rare lone connections, high keeps the mesh densely strung with frequent triangle fills.

params.label: Depth layers
params.effect: How many mesh planes stack into depth; 1 is a single flat net, 3 builds a receding volume of finer dimmer webs behind the front one.

params.label: Depth fade
params.effect: How much each deeper layer dims relative to the one in front; low sinks the back layers into shadow, high keeps the whole stack bright.

params.label: Depth scale
params.effect: Cell-size ratio between successive layers; below 1 makes the back layers finer and denser (more distant), above 1 makes them coarser.

params.label: Thread glow
params.effect: Luminance and soft halo of the connecting threads; low draws them as faint hairlines, high lets the connections glow like lit filament.

params.label: Node size
params.effect: Radius of the node glow-dots; small leaves pinprick stars, large blooms them into soft luminous orbs.

params.label: Triangle fill
params.effect: Strength of the translucent triangle ghosts behind clustered triples; 0 removes the fills entirely, high stains the clusters with colour.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far the palette ranges across the net; low washes it in one hue, high cycles many colours node to node.
